description: This file contains automated tests for the Playwright CLI commands, specifically testing the behavior of 'npx playwright' commands such as '--help', 'codegen', and 'install' in a testing environment.

methods.name: test.use
methods.description: Configures the test environment with specific options like browser isolation and global install permissions.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for different CLI commands, including assertions on their behavior and output.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to verify the correctness of command outputs and side effects.

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^  const result = await exec('npx playwright install');$/

ctags.name: stdio
ctags.pattern: /^  const stdio = await exec('npx playwright codegen', { expectToExitWithError: true });$/
